description: This file defines the class writeexcel_worksheet, which extends writeexcel_biffwriter, and provides methods for creating and manipulating Excel worksheets, including setting properties, writing data (numbers, strings, formulas, URLs), configuring page layout, and handling internal Excel BIFF records. It is part of a PHP library ported from Perl for generating Excel files.

classes.name: writeexcel_worksheet
classes.description: Represents an Excel worksheet with methods to set properties, write data, and manage layout within a BIFF Excel file.

methods.name: writeexcel_worksheet
methods.description: Constructor for initializing worksheet with name, index, active sheet, parser, and temporary directory.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up a temporary file for worksheet data storage or falls back to in-memory storage.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the worksheet name.

methods.name: set_column
methods.description: Sets the width, format, and visibility of a range of columns.

methods.name: set_selection
methods.description: Selects a specific cell or range in the worksheet.

methods.name: freeze_panes
methods.description: Defines frozen panes at a specific cell location.

methods.name: thaw_panes
methods.description: Removes frozen panes, allowing scrolling.

methods.name: set_portrait
methods.description: Sets page orientation to portrait.

methods.name: set_landscape
methods.description: Sets page orientation to landscape.

methods.name: set_paper
methods.description: Chooses paper size type for printing.

methods.name: set_header
methods.description: Sets page header text and margin.

methods.name: set_footer
methods.description: Sets page footer text and margin.

methods.name: center_horizontally
methods.description: Centers the worksheet content horizontally.

methods.name: center_vertically
methods.description: Centers the worksheet content vertically.

methods.name: set_margins
methods.description: Sets all page margins equally.

methods.name: set_margins_LR
methods.description: Sets left and right page margins.

methods.name: set_margins_TB
methods.description: Sets top and bottom page margins.

methods.name: set_margin_left
methods.description: Sets the left page margin.

methods.name: set_margin_right
methods.description: Sets the right page margin.

methods.name: set_margin_top
methods.description: Sets the top page margin.

methods.name: set_margin_bottom
methods.description: Sets the bottom page margin.

methods.name: repeat_rows
methods.description: Specifies rows to repeat on each printed page.

methods.name: repeat_columns
methods.description: Specifies columns to repeat on each printed page.

methods.name: print_area
methods.description: Defines the print area of the worksheet.

methods.name: hide_gridlines
methods.description: Hides or shows gridlines on screen and print.

methods.name: print_row_col_headers
methods.description: Configures printing of row and column headers.

methods.name: fit_to_pages
methods.description: Sets the number of pages the worksheet should fit in during print.

methods.name: set_h_pagebreaks
methods.description: Sets horizontal page breaks.

methods.name: set_v_pagebreaks
methods.description: Sets vertical page breaks.

methods.name: set_zoom
methods.description: Sets worksheet zoom percentage.

methods.name: set_print_scale
methods.description: Sets the scale for printed output.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Dispatches to write_number, write_string, write_formula, write_url, or write_blank based on token pattern.

methods.name: write_row
methods.description: Writes an array of data across a row starting at specified cell.

methods.name: _XF
methods.description: Returns an XF index for cell formatting based on row, column, or format object.

methods.name: write_col
methods.description: Writes an array of data down a column starting at specified cell.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Stores worksheet data in a buffer or temporary file.

methods.name: _substitute_cellref
methods.description: Converts Excel cell references in A1 notation to internal row and column indices.

methods.name: _cell_to_rowcol
methods.description: Converts an A1 notation cell reference to zero-based row and column indices.

methods.name: _sort_pagebreaks
methods.description: Removes duplicates, sorts, and limits page breaks.

methods.name: _encode_password
methods.description: Encodes a password for sheet protection (not fully implemented).

methods.name: write_number
methods.description: Writes a numeric cell value.

methods.name: write_string
methods.description: Writes a string cell value, with length limit.

methods.name: write_blank
methods.description: Writes a blank cell with a format, used for formatting without data.

methods.name: write_formula
methods.description: Writes a formula cell, parsing formula text.

methods.name: write_url
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink cell, calling specific submethods based on URL type.

methods.name: write_url_range
methods.description: Handles writing hyperlinks spanning cell ranges.

methods.name: _write_url_web
methods.description: Writes HTTP, FTP, or mailto hyperlinks.

methods.name: _write_url_internal
methods.description: Writes internal sheet reference hyperlinks.

methods.name: _write_url_external
methods.description: Writes absolute external URL hyperlinks.

methods.name: _write_url_external_net
methods.description: Writes network drive URL hyperlinks.

methods.name: merge_cells
methods.description: Creates a merged cell range, handling references and ordering.

methods.name: _store_panes
methods.description: Writes the Excel BIFF PANE record, handling frozen or thawed panes.

methods.name: _store_setup
methods.description: Stores the page setup BIFF record, including paper size, scaling, orientation, and margins.

methods.name: _store_header
methods.description: Stores the header caption BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_footer
methods.description: Stores the footer caption BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_hcenter
methods.description: Stores the horizontal centering BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_vcenter
methods.description: Stores the vertical centering BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_margin_left
methods.description: Stores the left margin BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_margin_right
methods.description: Stores the right margin BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_margin_top
methods.description: Stores the top margin BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_margin_bottom
methods.description: Stores the bottom margin BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_print_headers
methods.description: Stores the print headers BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_print_gridlines
methods.description: Stores the print gridlines BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_gridset
methods.description: Stores the gridset BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_wsbool
methods.description: Stores the worksheet boolean BIFF record, e.g., fit to page.

methods.name: _store_hbreak
methods.description: Stores horizontal page breaks BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_vbreak
methods.description: Stores vertical page breaks BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_protect
methods.description: Stores the sheet protection BIFF record.

methods.name: _store_password

methods.name: insert_bitmap
methods.description: Inserts a bitmap image into the worksheet at specified position and scale.

methods.name: _position_image
methods.description: Calculates the vertices for positioning an image anchored to specific cells and offsets.

methods.name: _size_col
methods.description: Converts a column width to pixels.

methods.name: _size_row
methods.description: Converts a row height to pixels.

methods.name: _store_obj_picture
methods.description: Stores the OBJ record for an inserted picture, including position and style.

methods.name: _process_bitmap
methods.description: Processes a bitmap file, extracting size and image data for embedding.
